items.source: beanName - the name of the bean
items.translation: beanName - 豆子的名称

items.source: existingBean - the existing bean instance
items.translation: existingBean - 现有的 Bean 实例

items.source: mbd - the merged bean definition for the bean
items.translation: mbd - 该 Bean 的合并 Bean 定义

items.source: mbd - the bean definition for the bean
items.translation: mbd - 该 Bean 的 Bean 定义

items.source: a BeanWrapper for the new instance
items.translation: 新实例的 BeanWrapper

items.source: Overridden to clear FactoryBean instance cache as well.
items.translation: 重写以同时清除 FactoryBean 实例缓存。

items.source:
Extract a filtered set of PropertyDescriptors from the given BeanWrapper,
excluding ignored dependency types or properties defined on ignored dependency interfaces.
items.translation: 从给定的 BeanWrapper 中提取一组过滤后的 PropertyDescriptors，排除被忽略的依赖类型或在被忽略的依赖接口上定义的属性。

items.source: beanName - the name of the bean, to be passed to it if necessary (only passed to BeanPostProcessors; can follow the AutowireCapableBeanFactory.ORIGINAL_INSTANCE_SUFFIX convention in order to enforce the given instance to be returned, i.e. no proxies etc)
items.translation: beanName - bean 的名称，必要时会传递给它 （仅传递给 BeanPostProcessors； 可以遵循 AutowireCapableBeanFactory.ORIGINAL_INSTANCE_SUFFIX 约定，以强制返回给定的实例，即不返回代理等）

items.source: args - explicit arguments to use for constructor or factory method invocation
items.translation: args - 用于构造函数或工厂方法调用的显式参数

items.source: beanName - the name of the bean (for error handling purposes)
items.translation: beanName - 豆子的名称（用于错误处理）

items.source: bw - the BeanWrapper the bean was created with
items.translation: bw - 创建该 Bean 所使用的 BeanWrapper

items.source: the bean instance to use, either the original or a wrapped one
items.translation: 要使用的 Bean 实例，即原始实例或包装后的实例。

items.source: Does not apply standard BeanPostProcessors callbacks or perform any further initialization of the bean. This interface offers distinct, fine-grained operations for those purposes, for example AutowireCapableBeanFactory.initializeBean(Object, String). However, InstantiationAwareBeanPostProcessor callbacks are applied, if applicable to the configuration of the instance.
items.translation: not 不应用标准的 BeanPostProcessors回调或执行任何进一步的 bean 初始化。该接口为此目的提供了不同的、细粒度的操作，例如AutowireCapableBeanFactory.initializeBean(Object, String)。然而，如果适用于实例的配置，则会应用 InstantiationAwareBeanPostProcessor回调。

items.source: Determine candidate constructors to use for the given bean, checking all registered SmartInstantiationAwareBeanPostProcessors.
items.translation: 确定要用于给定 Bean 的候选构造函数，检查所有已注册的SmartInstantiationAwareBeanPostProcessors。

items.source: BeansException - if instantiation or wiring failed
items.translation: BeansException - 如果实例化或装配失败

items.source: BeanCreationException - if the bean could not be created
items.translation: BeanCreationException - 如果无法创建该 Bean

items.source: typesToMatch - the types to match in case of internal type matching purposes (also signals that the returned Class will never be exposed to application code)
items.translation: typesToMatch - 内部类型匹配时用于匹配的类型（同时也表示返回的 Class 将永远不会暴露给应用程序代码）

items.source: explicitArgs - argument values passed in programmatically via the getBean method, or null if none (implying the use of constructor argument values from bean definition)
items.translation: `explicitArgs` - 通过 getBean 方法以编程方式传递的参数值，或为 null（表示使用来自 Bean 定义的构造函数参数值）。

items.source: autowireMode - by name or type, using the constants in this interface
items.translation: autowireMode - 通过此接口中的常量按名称或类型进行自动注入。

items.source: the type for the bean if determinable, or null otherwise
items.translation: 如果可确定则返回 Bean 的类型，否则返回null。

items.source: mbd - the merged bean definition
items.translation: mbd - 合并后的 Bean 定义

items.source: bw - the BeanWrapper from which we can obtain information about the bean
items.translation: bw - 我们可以从中获取有关 Bean 信息的 BeanWrapper

items.source: pvs - the PropertyValues to register wired objects with
items.translation: pvs - 要注册已连线对象的属性值

items.source: mbd - the merged bean definition the bean was created with
items.translation: mbd - 创建该 Bean 时使用的合并后的 Bean 定义

items.source: beanName - the bean name in the factory (for debugging purposes)
items.translation: beanName - 工厂中的 Bean 名称（用于调试目的）

items.source: bean - the new bean instance we may need to initialize
items.translation: bean - 我们可能需要初始化的新 bean 实例

items.source: the new bean instance
items.translation: 新的 Bean 实例

items.source: a new instance of the bean
items.translation: bean 的新实例

items.source: the filtered PropertyDescriptors
items.translation: 已筛选的 PropertyDescriptors

items.source: Note that this class does not assume or implement bean definition registry capabilities. See DefaultListableBeanFactory for an implementation of the ListableBeanFactory and BeanDefinitionRegistry interfaces, which represent the API and SPI view of such a factory, respectively.
items.translation: 注意，该类并不假设或实现 bean 定义注册功能。有关 `ListableBeanFactory` 和 `BeanDefinitionRegistry` 接口的实现（它们分别代表此类工厂的 API 和 SPI 视图），请参阅DefaultListableBeanFactory。

items.source: Does not apply standard BeanPostProcessors callbacks or perform any further initialization of the bean. This interface offers distinct, fine-grained operations for those purposes, for example AutowireCapableBeanFactory.initializeBean(Object, String). However, InstantiationAwareBeanPostProcessor callbacks are applied, if applicable to the construction of the instance.
items.translation: not 不应用标准的 BeanPostProcessors回调或执行任何进一步的 bean 初始化。该接口为此目的提供了不同的、细粒度的操作，例如AutowireCapableBeanFactory.initializeBean(Object, String)。然而，如果适用于实例的构建，则会应用 InstantiationAwareBeanPostProcessor回调。

items.source: Performs full initialization of the bean, including all applicable BeanPostProcessors. This is effectively a superset of what AutowireCapableBeanFactory.autowire(Class, int, boolean) provides, adding AutowireCapableBeanFactory.initializeBean(Object, String) behavior.
items.translation: 执行 bean 的完整初始化，包括所有适用的BeanPostProcessors。这实际上是AutowireCapableBeanFactory.autowire(Class, int, boolean)所提供内容的超集，并添加了AutowireCapableBeanFactory.initializeBean(Object, String)的行为。

items.source: The main template method to be implemented by subclasses is AutowireCapableBeanFactory.resolveDependency(DependencyDescriptor, String, Set, TypeConverter), used for autowiring. In case of a ListableBeanFactory which is capable of searching its bean definitions, matching beans will typically be implemented through such a search. Otherwise, simplified matching can be implemented.
items.translation: 子类要实现的主要模板方法是 AutowireCapableBeanFactory.resolveDependency(DependencyDescriptor, String, Set, TypeConverter)，用于自动装配。对于能够搜索其 bean 定义的 ListableBeanFactory，匹配的 bean 通常通过此类搜索来实现。否则，可以实现简化的匹配。

items.source: This will typically be used by application contexts to register dependencies that are resolved in other ways, like BeanFactory through BeanFactoryAware or ApplicationContext through ApplicationContextAware.
items.translation: 这通常由应用上下文使用，以注册通过其他方式解析的依赖项，例如通过 `BeanFactoryAware` 解析 `BeanFactory`，或通过 `ApplicationContextAware` 解析 `ApplicationContext`。

items.source: This method does not autowire bean properties; it just applies explicitly defined property values. Use the AutowireCapableBeanFactory.autowireBeanProperties(Object, int, boolean) method to autowire an existing bean instance. Note: This method requires a bean definition for the given name!
items.translation: 此方法不会自动注入 Bean 属性；它仅应用显式定义的属性值。请使用AutowireCapableBeanFactory.autowireBeanProperties(Object, int, boolean)方法对现有的 Bean 实例进行自动注入。注意：此方法需要给定名称的 Bean 定义！

items.source: Called from createBean(Class) for traditionally defined beans, and from initializeBean(Object, String) for existing bean instances.
items.translation: 由传统的 Bean 定义调用自createBean(Class)，或由现有的 Bean 实例调用自initializeBean(Object, String)。

items.source: By default, the BeanNameAware, BeanFactoryAware, and BeanClassLoaderAware interfaces are ignored. For further types to ignore, invoke this method for each type.
items.translation: 默认情况下，会忽略 `BeanNameAware`、`BeanFactoryAware` 和 `BeanClassLoaderAware` 接口。若要忽略更多类型，请为每种类型调用此方法。

items.source: Note: This is essentially intended for (re-)populating annotated fields and methods, either for new instances or for deserialized instances. It does not imply traditional by-name or by-type autowiring of properties; use AutowireCapableBeanFactory.autowireBeanProperties(Object, int, boolean) for those purposes.
items.translation: 注意：这本质上旨在为新的实例或反序列化的实例重新填充已注解的字段和方法。它不意味着按名称或按类型的传统属性自动装配；请使用 AutowireCapableBeanFactory.autowireBeanProperties(Object, int, boolean) 来实现这些目的。

items.source: This is effectively a superset of what AutowireCapableBeanFactory.initializeBean(Object, String) provides, fully applying the configuration specified by the corresponding bean definition. Note: This method requires a bean definition for the given name!
items.translation: 这实际上是 `AutowireCapableBeanFactory.initializeBean(Object, String)` 所提供内容的超集，完全应用了对应 bean 定义中指定的配置。 注意：此方法需要给定名称的 bean 定义！

items.source: Default is a DefaultParameterNameDiscoverer.
items.translation: 默认值为一个DefaultParameterNameDiscoverer。

items.source: Performs full initialization of the bean, including all applicable BeanPostProcessors.
items.translation: 执行 Bean 的完整初始化，包括所有适用的 BeanPostProcessors。

items.source: Note: This is intended for creating a fresh instance, populating annotated fields and methods as well as applying all standard bean initialization callbacks. Constructor resolution is based on Kotlin primary / single public / single non-public, with a fallback to the default constructor in ambiguous scenarios, also influenced by SmartInstantiationAwareBeanPostProcessor.determineCandidateConstructors(Class, String) (for example, for annotation-driven constructor selection).
items.translation: 注意：此功能旨在创建新实例，填充已注解的字段和方法，并应用所有标准的 Bean 初始化回调。构造函数的解析基于 Kotlin 的主构造函数/单个公共构造函数/单个非公共构造函数，在存在歧义的场景下会回退到默认构造函数，同时也受 SmartInstantiationAwareBeanPostProcessor.determineCandidateConstructors(Class, String) 的影响（例如，用于注解驱动的构造函数选择）。

items.source: This implementation determines the type matching createBean(Class)'s different creation strategies. As far as possible, we'll perform static type checking to avoid creation of the target bean.
items.translation: 此实现确定与createBean(Class)的不同创建策略的类型匹配。在尽可能范围内，我们将执行静态类型检查以避免创建目标 Bean。

items.source: This means checking whether the bean implements InitializingBean or defines any custom init methods, and invoking the necessary callback(s) if it does.
items.translation: 这意味着检查该 Bean 是否实现了InitializingBean接口或定义了任何自定义初始化方法，如果是，则调用相应的回调。

items.source: Called by invokeInitMethods(String, Object, RootBeanDefinition).
items.translation: 由invokeInitMethods(String, Object, RootBeanDefinition)调用。

items.source: NOTE: It is generally recommended to not rely on circular references between your beans. Refactor your application logic to have the two beans involved delegate to a third bean that encapsulates their common logic.
items.translation: 注意： 通常不建议依赖圈引用。请重构应用程序逻辑，使涉及的这两个 Bean 委托给一个封装其公共逻辑的第三个 Bean。

items.source: NOTE: It is generally recommended to not rely on circular references between your beans, in particular with auto-proxying involved.
items.translation: 注意： 通常不建议依赖圈状引用，特别是涉及自动代理时。

items.source: Any returned object will be used as the bean instead of actually instantiating the target bean. A null return value from the post-processor will result in the target bean being instantiated.
items.translation: 任何返回的对象都将作为 Bean 使用，而不会实际实例化目标 Bean。如果后置处理器返回 `null`，则目标 Bean 将被实例化。

items.source:
Provides bean creation (with constructor resolution), property population,
wiring (including autowiring), and initialization. Handles runtime bean
references, resolves managed collections, calls initialization methods, etc.
Supports autowiring constructors, properties by name, and properties by type.
items.translation: 提供 Bean 的创建（包括构造函数解析）、属性填充、装配（包括自动装配）和初始化。处理运行时 Bean 引用，解析托管集合，调用初始化方法等。支持按名称和按类型进行构造函数的自动装配以及属性的自动装配。

items.source:
Note that circular reference resolution means that one of the involved beans
will receive a reference to another bean that is not fully initialized yet.
This can lead to subtle and not-so-subtle side effects on initialization;
it does work fine for many scenarios, though.
items.translation: 请注意，循环引用解析意味着其中一个涉及的 Bean 将接收到对另一个尚未完全初始化的 Bean 的引用。这可能会导致初始化过程中出现微妙或不那么微妙的副作用；不过，在许多场景中它仍然可以正常工作。

items.source:
Default is "true". Turn this off to throw an exception when encountering
a circular reference, disallowing them completely.
items.translation: 默认为"true"。将其关闭以在遇到循环引用时抛出异常，从而完全禁止它们。

items.source:
This will only be used as a last resort in case of a circular reference
that cannot be resolved otherwise: essentially, preferring a raw instance
getting injected over a failure of the entire bean wiring process.
items.translation: 这仅在无法通过其他方式解决循环引用时作为最后手段使用：本质上，是优先选择注入原始实例，而不是整个 Bean 装配过程失败。

items.source:
Default is "false". Turn this on to allow for non-wrapped
raw beans injected into some of your references.
items.translation: 默认值为"false"。打开此选项以允许将非包装的原始 Bean 注入到某些引用中。

items.source:
Differentiates between default bean instantiation, use of a
factory method, and autowiring a constructor.
items.translation: 区分默认 Bean 实例化、使用工厂方法以及自动装配构造函数。

items.source:
This implementation is simplistic in that it is not able to
handle factory methods and InstantiationAwareBeanPostProcessors.
It only predicts the bean type correctly for a standard bean.
To be overridden in subclasses, applying more sophisticated type detection.
items.translation: 此实现过于简单，无法处理工厂方法和 `InstantiationAwareBeanPostProcessor`。它仅能正确预测标准 Bean 的 Bean 类型。应在子类中重写该方法，以应用更复杂的类型检测机制。

items.source:
The shortcut check for a FactoryBean is only applied in case of a singleton
FactoryBean. If the FactoryBean instance itself is not kept as singleton,
it will be fully created to check the type of its exposed object.
items.translation: FactoryBean 的快捷检查仅适用于单例 FactoryBean。如果 FactoryBean 实例本身未被保留为单例，则将完全创建它以检查其暴露对象的类型。

items.source:
This corresponds to constructor injection: In this mode, a Spring
bean factory is able to host components that expect constructor-based
dependency resolution.
items.translation: 这对应于构造函数注入：在这种模式下，Spring 容器能够托管那些期望基于构造函数的依赖解析的组件。

items.source:
This is like PicoContainer default, in which there must be exactly one bean
of the property type in the bean factory. This makes bean factories simple to
configure for small namespaces, but doesn't work as well as standard Spring
behavior for bigger applications.
items.translation: 这类似于 PicoContainer 的默认行为，即 BeanFactory 中必须恰好存在一个指定属性类型的 Bean。这使得 BeanFactory 在小命名空间中易于配置，但对于大型应用程序，其效果不如标准的 Spring 行为。

items.source:
This implementation excludes properties defined by CGLIB and
properties whose type matches an ignored dependency type or which
are defined by an ignored dependency interface.
items.translation: 此实现排除了由 CGLIB 定义的属性、类型与忽略的依赖类型匹配的属性，或由忽略的依赖接口定义的属性。

items.source:
Can be overridden in subclasses for custom resolution of init methods
with arguments.
items.translation: 可在子类中重写，以自定义带参数的初始化方法的解析。

items.source: Destroy the given bean instance (typically coming from AutowireCapableBeanFactory.createBean(Class)), applying the DisposableBean contract as well as registered DestructionAwareBeanPostProcessors.
items.translation: 销毁给定的 Bean 实例（通常来自AutowireCapableBeanFactory.createBean(Class)），同时应用DisposableBean契约以及已注册的DestructionAwareBeanPostProcessors。

items.source: Apply BeanPostProcessors to the given existing bean instance, invoking their postProcessBeforeInitialization methods. The returned bean instance may be a wrapper around the original.
items.translation: 将 `BeanPostProcessors` 应用于给定的现有 Bean 实例，调用它们的 `postProcessBeforeInitialization` 方法。返回的 Bean 实例可能是原始实例的包装器。

items.translation: 描述从接口复制：AutowireCapableBeanFactory

items.source: Apply BeanPostProcessors to the given existing bean instance, invoking their postProcessAfterInitialization methods. The returned bean instance may be a wrapper around the original.
items.translation: 将 `BeanPostProcessors` 应用于给定的现有 Bean 实例，调用它们的 `postProcessAfterInitialization` 方法。返回的 Bean 实例可能是原始实例的包装器。

items.translation: 描述从类复制：AbstractBeanFactory

items.source: Overridden in order to implicitly register the currently created bean as dependent on further beans getting programmatically retrieved during a Supplier callback.
items.translation: 重写以隐式注册当前创建的 Bean，使其依赖于在 `Supplier` 回调期间通过编程方式检索的其他 Bean。

items.source: Apply MergedBeanDefinitionPostProcessors to the specified bean definition, invoking their postProcessMergedBeanDefinition methods.
items.translation: 将 MergedBeanDefinitionPostProcessors 应用于指定的 BeanDefinition，并调用它们的 `postProcessMergedBeanDefinition` 方法。

items.source: Applies the postProcessAfterInitialization callback of all registered BeanPostProcessors, giving them a chance to post-process the object obtained from FactoryBeans (for example, to auto-proxy them).
items.translation: 应用所有已注册的 BeanPostProcessor 的postProcessAfterInitialization回调，让它们有机会对从 FactoryBeans 获取的对象进行后处理（例如，自动为其创建代理）。

items.source: Create a new AbstractAutowireCapableBeanFactory.
items.translation: 创建一个新的 AbstractAutowireCapableBeanFactory。

items.source: Create a new AbstractAutowireCapableBeanFactory with the given parent.
items.translation: 使用给定的父对象创建一个新的 AbstractAutowireCapableBeanFactory。

items.source:
Fill in any missing property values with references to
other beans in this factory if autowire is set to "byName".
items.translation: 如果将 autowire 设置为"byName"，则使用此工厂中其他 bean 的引用来填充任何缺失的属性值。

items.source:
Central method of this class: creates a bean instance,
populates the bean instance, applies post-processors, etc.
items.translation: 本类的核心方法：创建 Bean 实例，填充 Bean 实例，应用后置处理器等。

items.source:
Create a new instance for the specified bean, using an appropriate instantiation strategy:
factory method, constructor autowiring, or simple instantiation.
items.translation: 为指定的 Bean 创建新实例，使用适当的实例化策略：工厂方法、构造函数自动装配或简单实例化。

items.source: Determine the target type for the given bean definition.
items.translation: 确定给定 Bean 定义的目标类型。

items.source:
Obtain a reference for early access to the specified bean,
typically for the purpose of resolving a circular reference.
items.translation: 获取对指定 Bean 的早期访问引用，通常用于解决循环引用问题。

items.source: Return the instantiation strategy to use for creating bean instances.
items.translation: 返回用于创建 Bean 实例的实例化策略。

items.source:
Return the ParameterNameDiscoverer to use for resolving method parameter
names if needed.
items.translation: 如需解析方法参数名称，请返回要使用的 ParameterNameDiscoverer。

items.source: Instantiate the given bean using its default constructor.
items.translation: 使用其默认构造函数实例化给定的 Bean。

items.source: Return whether to allow circular references between beans.
items.translation: 返回是否允许在 Bean 之间存在循环引用。

items.source: Return whether to allow the raw injection of a bean instance.
items.translation: 返回是否允许原始注入 Bean 实例。

items.source: Obtain a bean instance from the given supplier.
items.translation: 从给定的供应者获取一个 Bean 实例。

items.source:
Populate the bean instance in the given BeanWrapper with the property values
from the bean definition.
items.translation: 在指定的 BeanWrapper 中，使用 BeanDefinition 中的属性值填充 Bean 实例。

items.source:
Apply before-instantiation post-processors, resolving whether there is a
before-instantiation shortcut for the specified bean.
items.translation: 应用前置实例化后置处理器，解析指定 Bean 是否存在前置实例化快捷方式。

items.source: Resolve the specified dependency against the beans defined in this factory.
items.translation: 解析该工厂中定义的 bean 以解决指定的依赖关系。

items.source:
Set the instantiation strategy to use for creating bean instances.
Default is CglibSubclassingInstantiationStrategy.
items.translation: 设置用于创建 Bean 实例的实例化策略。默认值为 CglibSubclassingInstantiationStrategy。

items.source:
Instantiate the bean using a named factory method. The method may be static, if the
mbd parameter specifies a class, rather than a factoryBean, or an instance variable
on a factory object itself configured using Dependency Injection.
items.translation: 使用命名工厂方法实例化该 Bean。如果 `mbd` 参数指定的是一个类（而不是 `factoryBean`），或者是一个在工厂对象本身上使用依赖注入配置的实例变量，则该方法可以是静态的。

items.source:
Return an array of non-simple bean properties that are unsatisfied.
These are probably unsatisfied references to other beans in the
factory. Does not include simple properties like primitives or Strings.
items.translation: 返回一个未满足的非简单 Bean 属性的数组。这些属性很可能是对工厂中其他 Bean 的未满足引用。不包括基本类型或 String 等简单属性。

items.source: Configure the given raw bean: autowiring bean properties, applying bean property values, applying factory callbacks such as setBeanName and setBeanFactory, and also applying all bean post processors (including ones which might wrap the given raw bean).

items.source: Initialize the given raw bean, applying factory callbacks such as setBeanName and setBeanFactory, also applying all bean post processors (including ones which might wrap the given raw bean).

items.source: Apply InstantiationAwareBeanPostProcessors to the specified bean definition (by class and name), invoking their postProcessBeforeInstantiation methods.

and bean property post-processing (for example, for annotation-driven injection).
